important_rules: Do not directly join idtransaksi on m4_vpp_detail, m4_vp_detail, or m4_pie_detail without checking the sumber column.
Use header tables for document numbers, dates, suppliers, statuses, and total transaction values.
Use detail tables for items, quantities, prices, vendor comparison, and goods progress.
Distinguish vendor payment proposals (m4_vpp) from realized vendor payments (m4_vp).
Use m4_cs and m4_bs for vendor-evaluation or quotation-selection analytics.
Use m4_ipc for additional purchasing cost or landed cost.
Avoid custom* fields unless they are explicitly required by the user or report.

query_patterns.name: document_summary
query_patterns.pattern: Use header tables such as m4_po, m4_ri, or m4_ap for transaction numbers, dates, suppliers, statuses, and totals.

query_patterns.name: document_items
query_patterns.pattern: Join headers to detail, for example m4_po -> m4_po_detail or m4_ri -> m4_ri_detail.

query_patterns.name: purchase_flow_trace
query_patterns.description: Trace the purchasing flow from request to invoice.
query_patterns.pattern: Start from detail: PR -> PR_DETAIL -> RQ_DETAIL -> BS_DETAIL -> PO_DETAIL -> GRN_DETAIL -> RI_DETAIL.

query_patterns.name: purchase_return_trace
query_patterns.description: Trace purchase returns from invoice to debit note or return.

query_patterns.name: vendor_payment_trace
query_patterns.description: Trace vendor payment proposals and realized vendor payments.
query_patterns.pattern: VPP -> VPP_DETAIL -> VP_DETAIL -> VP, with sumber checks on idtransaksi.

caution_areas: Questions spanning AP, RI, and PRT through m4_vpp_detail.
Vendor payment questions that use m4_vp_detail.idtransaksi.
History questions that mix active and history tables.
Questions that rely on custom* fields without a clear report reference.
